title: Translating Parkinson disease genetics into clinical benefit
title_zh: 将帕金森病遗传学转化为临床获益
abstract: Parkinson disease (PD) is a heterogeneous neurodegenerative disorder characterized by variable progression and treatment response. Over the past three decades, genetic discoveries have reshaped our understanding of PD biology, identifying rare monogenic forms, strong genetic risk variants and a large set of common and rare genetic variants variably contributing to PD heritability. These findings led to the identification of key pathways implicated in the neurodegenerative process, including protein misprocessing, lysosomal and mitochondrial impairment, and altered immune response. In this Review, we describe the evolution of PD genetics and discuss its current clinical impact and future role in shaping precision medicine, from diagnosis and prognosis to the development of disease-modifying therapies. Genetic information is increasingly used to support clinical decision-making, improve patient counselling and identify biologically distinct forms of PD. Importantly, genetic insights are driving therapeutic innovation, enabling targeted strategies and genetically stratified clinical trials. Despite ongoing challenges such as incomplete penetrance, variable expression of disease and missing heritability across multiple ancestries, integrating genetic knowledge into research and clinical practice is accelerating the transition towards precision medicine in PD, providing a framework for more personalized care and improved patient outcomes. Genetic discoveries in Parkinson disease (PD), from rare monogenic mutations to common risk variants, have clarified key determinants of disease risk and variability. This Review highlights the evolution of PD genetics, its current clinical relevance for diagnosis, counselling and therapeutic management, and its future role in enabling patient stratification and advancing precision medicine approaches in PD.
abstract_zh: 帕金森病（PD）是一种异质性的神经退行性疾病，其特征是进展和治疗反应的可变性。在过去的三十年中，遗传学发现重塑了我们对PD生物学的理解，鉴定出罕见的单基因形式、强遗传风险变异以及对PD遗传性贡献各异的大量常见和罕见遗传变异。这些发现导致鉴定出参与神经退行性过程的关键途径，包括蛋白质加工错误、溶酶体和线粒体功能障碍以及免疫反应改变。在本综述中，我们描述了PD遗传学的演变，并讨论了其当前的临床影响及在精准医疗中的未来作用，从诊断、预后到疾病修饰疗法的开发。遗传信息越来越多地用于支持临床决策、改善患者咨询并鉴定PD的生物学不同形式。重要的是，遗传洞察正在驱动治疗创新，使针对性策略和基因分层临床试验成为可能。尽管仍面临完整缺失性、疾病表现的可变性以及跨多个族群的缺失遗传性等持续挑战，但将遗传知识融入研究和临床实践正在加速PD向精准医疗的转变，为更个性化的护理和改善患者预后提供了框架。遗传学发现从罕见的单基因突变到常见风险变异，阐明了PD的关键致病因素和变异性。本综述强调了PD遗传学的演变、诊断、咨询和治疗管理的当前临床相关性，以及其在促进患者分层和推进PD精准医疗方法中的未来作用。
